correctness.rationale: Symmetrize any linear extension over within-cluster permutations, so new value is a signed cluster-mean functional ∑α_i average_i with ∑α_i=1. The finite clustered metric embeds as leaves of a weighted tree, which gives exact Kantorovich–Rubinstein norm of μ−δ_x via sum of edge lengths times absolute subtree mass. Using that identity, transferring mass from negative to positive α never raises any new-point constraint, proving a positive optimum. On the α-simplex T_i=c−[c−a_i(1−1/m_i)]α_i; minimax equivalent to feasibility F(L)=∑(c−Lr_i)_+/d_i<=1, with unique root F(L*)=1. Active radii sorted give an O(k log k) arithmetic algorithm; old-pair norm enforces max{1,L*}. Assumptions check genuine metric, ties, singleton clusters and L*<1.
